title: F43 · first_mala · One Hundred and Eight
lines: One bead. One name. Do not rush.
"One bead. One name. Do not rush."
Pari wanted to know what Dadi does every morning with that necklace.
I am climbing a mountain, Dadi said. Sitting down.
"I am climbing a mountain," Dadi said. "Sitting down."
Thirty. She got bored. She looked at the ceiling. She started again from one.
The mountain does not mind, said Dadi. You just start walking again.
"The mountain does not mind," said Dadi. "You just start walking again."
It took her nine days to reach one hundred and eight without stopping.
On the ninth day she looked up, and for one second she saw the whole shelf full of light.
You will lose count. Start again. That is the whole path. That is sadhana.
